    Punjab Kings (PBKS) lead the IPL 2026 standings after defeating Chennai Super Kings (CSK) by 5 wickets in their second match. PBKS sits at the top of the table with a 2-0 record (4 points), while CSK is winless in their first two games.

    • CSK: 209/5 (Ayush Mhatre 73).
    • PBKS: 210/5 (Shreyas Iyer 50, Priyansh Arya 39).
    • Result: Punjab Kings won by 5 wickets, achieving their 9th successful 200+ run chase in IPL history.
